hunks.sol: Then one short command broke the stillness.

hunks.sol: Once they had been wrapped, Cheongpung raced toward me like a streak of light. I spoke to him gently.

hunks.baseline: “No, what do you mean, ‘hard to criticize’? You get angry every time I call you a beggar.”

hunks.sol: “Me? What nonsense. I’m a beggar from head to toe. I was born a beggar, and I’ll live as one until the day I die.”

hunks.baseline: “……You really are a beggar.”
hunks.sol: “……You really are a goddamn beggar.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin glared at Gung Gibang as if he wanted to kill him, then spoke again.
hunks.sol: After glaring at Gung Gibang as if he wanted to kill him, Hyuk Mujin spoke again.

hunks.baseline: Huashan Sect or not, Cheongpung was simply like that by nature.
hunks.sol: Huashan or whatever, Cheongpung had always been like that.

hunks.sol: That one sentence said it all. Hyuk Mujin muttered,

hunks.baseline: “……Just hit me ten times. Beat me until I die.”
hunks.sol: “……Just hit me ten times. Beat me to death.”

hunks.baseline: “I award bonus points for that determined attitude worthy of a martial artist. So one blow. How many?”
hunks.sol: “Bonus points for such resolve, worthy of a martial artist. So, one blow. How many?”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin shouted his reply with all his might and thrust his forehead forward.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin shouted his answer and thrust out his forehead.

hunks.baseline: In the middle of the road, which had fallen silent enough to hear a mouse breathe, ten men and women riding in four-person sedan chairs were looking in our direction with gazes that mixed displeasure and interest.
hunks.sol: The main road had gone deathly silent. Ten men and women seated in four-bearer palanquins were staring at us with a mixture of displeasure and interest.

hunks.baseline: Among them, all dressed lavishly as if to flaunt their immense wealth, one young man stood out in particular.
hunks.sol: All of them wore lavish clothing that flaunted their immense wealth, but one young man stood out in particular.

hunks.baseline: He was the owner of the voice I had heard moments earlier.
hunks.sol: He was the one who had just spoken.

hunks.baseline: The young man’s eyes went round at my question. He blinked for a while, as if unable to believe what he had just heard, then let out a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: The young man’s eyes widened at my question. He blinked for a while, as if unable to believe what he had heard, then let out a quiet laugh.

hunks.baseline: “Do I have to know?”
hunks.sol: “Do I need to?”

hunks.baseline: “Have you ever seen such an arrogant bastard?”
hunks.sol: “What an arrogant bastard!”

hunks.baseline: The young man had not said that.
hunks.sol: The young man wasn’t the one who said that.

hunks.baseline: I looked at the man who had kicked off from the sedan chair and shot into the air.
hunks.sol: I watched as a man kicked off from one of the palanquins and shot into the air.

hunks.baseline: *What is this now?*
hunks.sol: *What’s this now?*

hunks.baseline: After performing three somersaults in midair, the sparrow-eyed man landed and drew his sword, his eyes burning with fury.
hunks.sol: The sparrow-eyed man performed three somersaults in midair before landing and drawing his sword, his eyes blazing with fury.

hunks.baseline: The spectators gasped at the dazzling movement.
hunks.sol: The onlookers gasped at the flashy display.

hunks.baseline: “You appear to be a wandering martial artist, but as if causing a disturbance in broad daylight were not enough, you dare to utter such insolent words to a person of—”
hunks.sol: “You appear to be a wandering martial artist, but as if causing a disturbance in broad daylight were not enough, you dare address a person of noble standing with such insolence—”

hunks.baseline: “You’ve put a lot of jewels on that. Are they meant to distract people?”
hunks.sol: “You’ve got a lot of jewels on that thing. Are they supposed to distract people?”

hunks.baseline: I stared at the jewels decorating his sword. Dozens of gems in a variety of colors were shining in the sunlight.
hunks.sol: I stared at the sword. Dozens of jewels of every kind gleamed in the sunlight.

hunks.baseline: “It’s dazzling. Put it away.”
hunks.sol: “They’re dazzling. Put it away.”

hunks.baseline: The sparrow-eyed man’s eyes widened.
hunks.sol: The sparrow-eyed man’s eyes bulged.

hunks.baseline: The sword flew from his grasp when he failed to withstand the force of the finger flick I sent at him. It spun through the air and plunged deep into the ground.
hunks.sol: Unable to withstand the force of my finger flick, the sword flew from his hand, spun through the air, and buried itself deep in the ground.

hunks.baseline: “You fucking bastard. How dare you point a sword at someone so carelessly? And in broad daylight, no less.”
hunks.sol: “Who the fuck points a sword at someone like that? In broad daylight, no less.”

hunks.baseline: *Oh, look at this bastard running his mouth.*
hunks.sol: *Oh, look at him throwing a fit.*

hunks.baseline: He seemed to have polished his skills to a decent level, but he was an extreme poseur obsessed with appearances.
hunks.sol: He seemed to have trained hard enough, but he was an insufferable poseur.

hunks.baseline: “And you were the ones making all the noise. I just made things quiet. Don’t make this more complicated than it needs to be. Just leave, all right?”
hunks.sol: “And you were the ones making all the noise. I just quieted things down. Don’t make this any more complicated than it needs to be. Just leave, all right?”

hunks.baseline: I was serious.
hunks.sol: I meant it.

hunks.baseline: It was not as though this was the first time one or two flies had buzzed around me. If I was merely passing through rather than standing in front of my own home, there was no reason to spray bug killer at every mosquito that came at me.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t as if I’d never had a fly or two buzzing around me before. This wasn’t my home, and I was only passing through. There was no reason to spray insecticide on every mosquito that came at me.

hunks.baseline: It would be better to wave them away and continue on my way.
hunks.sol: Better to wave them away and keep going.

hunks.baseline: But no matter how sincerely you tried to explain something, there were always people who could not understand it the first time.
hunks.sol: But no matter how sincerely you tried to explain something, there were always people who failed to understand the first time.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of sword blades flashed from every direction. As martial artists from Qingxia Hall wearing blue silk martial uniforms surrounded us in layer after layer, a smug expression appeared over the sparrow-eyed man’s earlier panic.
hunks.sol: Dozens of sword blades flashed from every direction. Martial artists from Qingxia Hall, dressed in blue silk martial uniforms, surrounded us in layer after layer. The sparrow-eyed man’s earlier panic gave way to smug satisfaction.

hunks.baseline: “You appear to be a fairly well-known wandering martial artist, but even now, kneel and beg for forgiveness. Who knows? Perhaps the Young Master will show you mercy.”
hunks.sol: “You seem to be a fairly well-known wandering martial artist. Kneel and beg forgiveness while you still can. Who knows? Perhaps the Young Master will mercifully spare you.”

hunks.baseline: I glanced over the sparrow-eyed man’s shoulder. The other men and women were watching us with bright, excited eyes, led by the young man who appeared to be their leader.
hunks.sol: I glanced over the sparrow-eyed man’s shoulder. Led by the young man who appeared to be their leader, the others were watching us with sparkling eyes.

hunks.baseline: They looked exactly like spectators watching monkeys at a zoo.
hunks.sol: They looked exactly like zoo visitors watching monkeys.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t think the people over there have any intention of showing mercy.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t think the people over there are feeling particularly merciful.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course, neither do I. And based on my experience so far, this is the most effective medicine. Isn’t that right?”
hunks.sol: “Of course, neither am I. And from what I’ve learned, this is the most effective medicine. Isn’t that right?”

hunks.baseline: I slowly raised my fist, and the Bermuda Triangle, which had been watching only my expression, responded enthusiastically.
hunks.sol: I raised my fist, and the Bermuda Triangle, who had been watching my every move, responded enthusiastically.

hunks.baseline: “Exactly. They won’t come to their senses until they’ve been beaten like dogs on the hottest day of summer.”
hunks.sol: “Exactly. They won’t come to their senses until they’ve been beaten like dogs on a midsummer day.”

hunks.baseline: “I was the first one to take that medicine. I was cured immediately.”
hunks.sol: “I was the first one to take that medicine. Cured me on the spot.”

hunks.baseline: “Benefactor, can I go buy some dumplings while you’re doing that?”
hunks.sol: “Benefactor, can I go buy dumplings while you do that?”

hunks.baseline: “No. Just stay there. It’ll be over soon anyway.”
hunks.sol: “No. Stay there. This’ll be over soon anyway.”

hunks.baseline: As I took a step forward, panic filled the sparrow-eyed man’s eyes.
hunks.sol: The moment I stepped forward, panic filled the sparrow-eyed man’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: A Third Rate thug would charge in out of sheer stubbornness because he would not know his opponent’s level. But that man was a martial artist who had learned martial arts to a certain degree.
hunks.sol: A third-rate street thug wouldn’t know his opponent’s level and would charge in out of sheer stubbornness. But this man was a martial artist who had attained a certain degree of skill.
